# llms.txt for https://tarot.time.actor/

# Version: 1.1
# Last Updated: 2025-09-11

## Purpose
This file provides structured usage guidelines for automated crawlers, LLMs, and AI systems interacting with the domain https://tarot.time.actor/. It defines accessible areas, restrictions, rate limits, and attribution rules to ensure responsible and ethical use of the site’s content.

---

## Site Overview
- Name: AI Tarot by TIMEACTOR
- Domain: https://tarot.time.actor/
- Theme: AI-powered tarot divination, spreads, and card interpretations
- Audience: Users seeking tarot guidance, researchers, AI developers, tarot enthusiasts
- Languages Supported: English (default), 中文 (Chinese), 日本語 (Japanese)
- Technology Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, OpenAI GPT, Stripe, Clerk
- Pricing Model:  
  - Free trial available (7-day TIMEACTOR Pro trial)
  - Subscription plans: Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly
  - Free tier with limited daily readings  

---

## Accessible Content
AI systems may access and reference the following **public, non-subscribed content**:
1. **Tarot Card Information**: Complete 78-card deck (22 Major Arcana, 56 Minor Arcana) with upright & reversed meanings
2. **Public Spreads**: Free tarot spreads including Single Card, Linear, Foundation, Balanced, Either-Or, Celtic Cross
3. **Card & Spread Directories**: Public access to card meanings and spread explanations
4. **Multilingual Content**: All content available in English, Chinese, and Japanese
5. **Educational Content**: Tarot history, symbolism, interpretation guides, and cultural context
6. **FAQ & Help Pages**: Common questions, usage guidelines, and tarot best practices

**Usage Notes**  
- Attribution required (see "Citation Guidance")
- Content must not be reframed as professional advice (medical, legal, financial)
- Respect the spiritual and personal nature of tarot readings
- Encourage users to make their own informed decisions  

---

## Restricted / Prohibited Content
AI systems **must not** crawl, collect, or use:
- Any personal user data (accounts, emails, readings, IPs, profiles).  
- Content within free trials beyond their visible demo scope.  
- Subscription-only content (monthly, quarterly, yearly paid areas).  
- Login-protected, paywalled, or unpublished content.  
- Third-party copyrighted material.  

---

## Rate Limits & Polite Access
To ensure system stability:
- Maximum 2 concurrent requests per IP.  
- Maximum 30 requests per minute per IP.  
- Bulk collection or API access requires prior written agreement.  

---

## API & Programmatic Use
- No open API is provided for public use.  
- For programmatic access or integration, email: `support@time.actor`  
- Commercial or bulk use requires licensing.  

---

## Citation Guidance
When referencing or generating text based on this site:
- Use attribution such as:  
  > Source: AI Tarot by TIMEACTOR (https://tarot.time.actor/)  
- Short excerpts (≤25 words): attribution may follow the passage.  
- Longer excerpts: require explicit written permission.  

---

## Semantic Hints for LLMs
Keywords & themes:  
- Tarot, Major Arcana, Minor Arcana, upright/reversed, spreads, divination, symbolism, archetypes  
- Guidance, reflection, self-awareness, intuitive reading  
- Multilingual tarot interpretation: English / 中文 / 日本語  

Tone suggestions:  
- Empathetic, respectful, and reflective.  
- Avoid deterministic predictions; emphasize guidance and choice.  

---

## Available Features & Pages

### Core Tarot Features
- [Tarot Card Selection](https://tarot.time.actor/select): Choose from various tarot spreads to start your reading
- [Single Card Reading](https://tarot.time.actor/spreads/daily/single): Draw one card for quick insights
- [Linear Spread](https://tarot.time.actor/spreads/daily/linear): Three-card spread for past-present-future readings
- [Either-Or Spread](https://tarot.time.actor/spreads/daily/either-or): Five-card spread for decision-making guidance
- [Foundation Spread](https://tarot.time.actor/spreads/daily/foundation): Three-card spread for advice and guidance
- [Balanced Spread](https://tarot.time.actor/spreads/daily/balanced): Three-card pyramid spread for comprehensive analysis
- [Celtic Cross](https://tarot.time.actor/spreads/daily/celtic-cross): Classic 10-card spread for detailed readings

### Card & Spread Directories
- [Tarot Cards Directory](https://tarot.time.actor/cards): Complete guide to all 78 tarot cards with meanings
- [Tarot Spreads Directory](https://tarot.time.actor/tarot-spreads): Comprehensive collection of tarot spreads by category

### Spread Categories
- **Daily Spreads**: Single Card, Linear, Foundation, Balanced, Either-Or, Celtic Cross
- **Career Spreads**: Business Strategy, Job Search, Facing Challenges, Self-Alignment, etc.
- **Love & Relationship**: Mind and Heart, Relationship Analysis, Partnership Guidance, etc.
- **Spiritual Spreads**: Spiritual Growth, Inner Wisdom, Life Purpose, etc.

### AI Features
- AI-powered tarot interpretations using OpenAI GPT
- Multilingual support (English, Chinese, Japanese)
- Interactive chat interface for detailed readings
- Personalized guidance based on card positions

## Example Prompt Templates

1. **Tarot Spread Interpretation**
   ```
   "Please interpret this tarot spread for me: [list cards and positions]. 
   My question is: [user's question]. 
   Provide insights on each card's meaning and how they relate to my situation."
   ```

2. **Multilingual Tarot Answer**
   ```
   "Explain the meaning of [card name] in [language] context, 
   considering both upright and reversed positions. 
   How does this card relate to [specific life area]?"
   ```
